BAGHAWI:92:10/r5.anchor: عن عطاء ،   قال : " كان لرجل من الأنصار نخلة وكان له جار يسقط من بلحها في داره

BAYDAWI:92:5/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:92:5/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:92:5/r1.claim: The following descriptions explain the divergent efforts just mentioned.

BAYDAWI:92:5/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:92:5/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:92:5/r2.claim: The generous person gives obedience and avoids disobedience.
BAYDAWI:92:5/r2.anchor: والمعنى من أعطى الطاعة واتقى المعصية

BIQAI:92:5/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:92:5/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:92:5/r1.claim: The section matches the oath to its subject and elaborates differing efforts and their recompense; it rejects the claim that all outcomes are alike, including the claim of people of unity, and reassures the Prophet that obedient people in this community are numerous.
BIQAI:92:5/r1.anchor: نبه بالقسم والتأكيد مع ظهور المقسم عليه على أنهم في أمنهم مع التحذير

BIQAI:92:5/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:92:5/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:92:5/r2.claim: The giver is one who gives in the way God has defined and commanded.
BIQAI:92:5/r2.anchor: وقع منه إعطاء على ما حددنا له وأمرناه به

BIQAI:92:5/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:92:5/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:92:5/r3.claim: Piety is taking protective measures through obedience and avoiding sins out of fear of God's punishment.
BIQAI:92:5/r3.anchor: اتخاذ الوقايات من الطاعات واجتناب المعاصي خوفاً من سطواتنا

BIQAI:92:5/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:92:5/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:92:5/r4.claim: Good and evil should not be assigned the same outcome: the categories distinguish those who purify themselves from those who corrupt them.
BIQAI:92:5/r4.anchor: لا يجوز تسوية المحسن بالمسيء ناشراً لمن زكى نفسه أو دساها

DURR:92:5/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:5/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:92:5/r1.claim: In the report through ʿIkrima, Ibn Abbas says the giver gives from his surplus and fears his Lord.
DURR:92:5/r1.anchor: من طريق عكرمة عن ابن عباس في قوله : { فأما من أعطى } من الفضل { واتقى } قال : اتقى ربه

DURR:92:5/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:5/r5.speaker: قتادة
DURR:92:5/r5.claim: Qatada says the giver fulfils God's due, avoids His prohibitions, and believes the promise God has made.
DURR:92:5/r5.anchor: عن قتادة { فأما من أعطى } قال : أعطى حق الله عليه { واتقى } محارم الله { وصدق بالحسنى } قال : بموعود الله على نفسه

DURR:92:5/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:5/r12.speaker: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير
DURR:92:5/r12.claim: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr recounts that Abu Bakr freed weak women and elderly converts despite his father's advice to free strong men; a family member said the verse was revealed about him because he sought God's reward.
DURR:92:5/r12.anchor: عن عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير قال : كان أبو بكر يعتق على الإسلام بمكة ،   فكان يعتق عجائز ونساء إذا أسلمن

DURR:92:5/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:5/r13.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:92:5/r13.claim: In a report through al-Kalbi and Abu Salih, Ibn Abbas identifies the giver as Abu Bakr and the miser who denies the good as Abu Sufyan ibn Harb.
DURR:92:5/r13.anchor: في طريق الكلبي عن أبي صالح عن ابن عباس في قوله : { فأما من أعطى واتقى وصدق بالحسنى فسنيسره لليسرى } قال : أبو بكر الصديق

DURR:92:5/r14.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:5/r14.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
DURR:92:5/r14.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet said each person's place in Paradise and Hell is written, yet commanded action: people are facilitated toward deeds of felicity or misery, then he recited these verses.
DURR:92:5/r14.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب قال : «كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في جنازة فقال : ما منكم من أحد إلا وقد كتب مقعده من الجنة ومقعده من النار

DURR:92:5/r15.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:5/r15.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي
DURR:92:5/r15.claim: Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami reports that after 54:49 was revealed, a man asked whether deeds were newly begun or already decreed; the Prophet replied to act, since each is facilitated toward ease or hardship.
DURR:92:5/r15.anchor: عن أبي عبد الرحمن السلمي قال : لما نزلت هذه الآية { إنا كل شيء خلقناه بقدر } [ القمر : 49 ] قال رجل : يا رسول الله ففيم العمل

DURR:92:7/r15.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:7/r15.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي
DURR:92:7/r15.claim: Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami reports that after 54:49 was revealed, a man asked whether deeds were newly begun or already decreed; the Prophet replied to act, since each is facilitated toward ease or hardship.
DURR:92:7/r15.anchor: عن أبي عبد الرحمن السلمي قال : لما نزلت هذه الآية { إنا كل شيء خلقناه بقدر } [ القمر : 49 ] قال رجل : يا رسول الله ففيم العمل

DURR:92:8/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:8/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:92:8/r1.claim: In the report through ʿIkrima, Ibn Abbas says the giver gives from his surplus and fears his Lord.
DURR:92:8/r1.anchor: من طريق عكرمة عن ابن عباس في قوله : { فأما من أعطى } من الفضل { واتقى } قال : اتقى ربه

DURR:92:8/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:8/r5.speaker: قتادة
DURR:92:8/r5.claim: Qatada says the giver fulfils God's due, avoids His prohibitions, and believes the promise God has made.
DURR:92:8/r5.anchor: عن قتادة { فأما من أعطى } قال : أعطى حق الله عليه { واتقى } محارم الله { وصدق بالحسنى } قال : بموعود الله على نفسه

DURR:92:8/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:8/r12.speaker: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير
DURR:92:8/r12.claim: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr recounts that Abu Bakr freed weak women and elderly converts despite his father's advice to free strong men; a family member said the verse was revealed about him because he sought God's reward.
DURR:92:8/r12.anchor: عن عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير قال : كان أبو بكر يعتق على الإسلام بمكة ،   فكان يعتق عجائز ونساء إذا أسلمن

DURR:92:8/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:8/r13.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:92:8/r13.claim: In a report through al-Kalbi and Abu Salih, Ibn Abbas identifies the giver as Abu Bakr and the miser who denies the good as Abu Sufyan ibn Harb.
DURR:92:8/r13.anchor: في طريق الكلبي عن أبي صالح عن ابن عباس في قوله : { فأما من أعطى واتقى وصدق بالحسنى فسنيسره لليسرى } قال : أبو بكر الصديق

DURR:92:8/r14.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:8/r14.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
DURR:92:8/r14.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet said each person's place in Paradise and Hell is written, yet commanded action: people are facilitated toward deeds of felicity or misery, then he recited these verses.
DURR:92:8/r14.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب قال : «كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في جنازة فقال : ما منكم من أحد إلا وقد كتب مقعده من الجنة ومقعده من النار

DURR:92:8/r15.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:8/r15.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي
DURR:92:8/r15.claim: Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami reports that after 54:49 was revealed, a man asked whether deeds were newly begun or already decreed; the Prophet replied to act, since each is facilitated toward ease or hardship.
DURR:92:8/r15.anchor: عن أبي عبد الرحمن السلمي قال : لما نزلت هذه الآية { إنا كل شيء خلقناه بقدر } [ القمر : 49 ] قال رجل : يا رسول الله ففيم العمل

DURR:92:17/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:17/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR:92:17/r2.claim: Asked whether deeds concern fixed decrees or future action, the Prophet says destiny is fixed but commands people to act, since each is eased for what they were created for; he recites 92:5–10.
DURR:92:17/r2.anchor: قال سراقة : ففيم العمل إذن يا رسول الله ؟ قال : اعملوا فكل ميسر لما خلق له

DURR:92:17/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:92:17/r3.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR:92:17/r3.claim: In another report, the Prophet says deeds accord with what the Pen and decrees fixed, yet tells people to act because each is eased for their created purpose, then recites 92:5–7.
DURR:92:17/r3.anchor: عن بشير بن كعب الأسلمي أن سائلاً سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فيم العمل قال : «فيما جفت به الأقلام وجرت به المقادير

IBNASHUR:92:5/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r1.claim: Fa-ammā elaborates the summary that striving differs; ammā carries both conditional force and the function of dividing the account into cases.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r1.anchor: تفريع وتفصيل للإجمال في قوله : { إن سعيكم لشتى }

IBNASHUR:92:5/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r2.claim: Tafṣīl distinguishes members of a previously shared group by a difference important to the discussion.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r2.anchor: والتفصيل : التفكيك بين متعدد اشتركت آحاده في حالة

IBNASHUR:92:5/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r3.claim: The subject needing division is striving, but the text divides by describing strivers; because actions accompany agents, this eloquent shift conveys both meanings.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r3.anchor: والمحتاج للتفصيل هنا هو السعي المذكور ، ولكن جعل التفصيل ببيان الساعين

IBNASHUR:92:5/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r4.claim: The shift from an action to its agent is illustrated by the poet's fear exceeding that of a watchful ibex.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r4.anchor: كقول النابغة : وقد خِفت حتى ما تزيد مخافتي

IBNASHUR:92:5/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r5.claim: Other examples express a quality through the person who has it, including ‘righteousness is whoever believes’ and comparison with a believer's faith.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r5.anchor: ومنه قوله تعالى : { ولكن البر من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر }

IBNASHUR:92:5/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r6.claim: The two main groups may be those enabled toward ease and those toward hardship, encompassing different deeds and serving exhortation and warning.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r6.anchor: فريق ميسر لليسرى وفريق ميسر للعسرى

IBNASHUR:92:5/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r7.claim: The division is also illustrated by the day people emerge separately to see their deeds, including outcomes of even the smallest good or evil.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r7.anchor: كقوله تعالى : { يومئذٍ يصدر الناس أشتاتاً ليروا أعمالهم

IBNASHUR:92:5/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r8.claim: Alternatively, the groups are the two sets of three traits stated in verses 5 and 8–9, a valid division of varied striving.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r8.anchor: واتّقى وصدّق بالحسنى ، ومنْ بخل واستغنى وكذب بالحسنى

IBNASHUR:92:5/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r9.claim: ‘Whoever’ is general, covering everyone who gives, is mindful of God, and affirms the good promise.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r9.anchor: يعُم كل من يفعل الإعطاء ويتقي ويصدِّق بالحسنى

IBNASHUR:92:5/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r10.claim: An ungraded occasion report links the verse to Abu Bakr buying Bilal from Umayya ibn Khalaf and freeing him to save him from torture.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r10.anchor: وروي أن هذا نزل بسبب أن أبا بكر اشترى بلالاً من أمية

IBNASHUR:92:5/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r11.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNASHUR:92:5/r11.claim: Some exegetes substitute Abu Sufyan ibn Harb for Umayya ibn Khalaf in the report; the author calls this an error.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r11.anchor: أبا سفيان بن حرب عوضَ أمية بن خلف ، وهم وهَم

IBNASHUR:92:5/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r12.claim: Another reported occasion concerns Abu al-Dahdah and a hypocrite; this would imply a Medinan sūra, but an occasion does not restrict the verse's general application.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r12.anchor: وقيل : نزلت في قضية أبي الدحداح مع رجل منافق ستأتي

IBNASHUR:92:5/r13.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r13.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r13.claim: The object of ‘gave’ is omitted because giving without return commonly means giving money; the intended giving is alms.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r13.anchor: لأن فعل الإعطاء إذا أريد به إعطاء المال بدون عوض

IBNASHUR:92:5/r14.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r14.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r14.claim: The object of ‘was mindful’ is omitted because the understood object is God.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r14.anchor: لأنه يعلم أن المقدّر اتّقى الله

IBNASHUR:92:5/r15.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r15.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r15.claim: Giving, God-consciousness, and belief in the good promise are traits of faith, so the description means being among believers.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r15.anchor: وهذه الخلال الثلاث من خلال الإيمان

IBNASHUR:92:5/r16.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r16.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r16.claim: The statement of Hell's denizens that they did not pray or feed the poor means they were not believers.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r16.anchor: أي لم نك من أهل الإيمان

IBNASHUR:92:5/r21.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:92:5/r21.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:92:5/r21.claim: Together, the three traits characterize a polytheist.
IBNASHUR:92:5/r21.anchor: وهذه الخلال كناية عن كونه من المشركين

IBNHIBBAN:335/r1.author: Ibn Ḥibbān
IBNHIBBAN:335/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
IBNHIBBAN:335/r1.claim: ʿAlī reports that the Prophet said each person's place in Paradise or Hell is recorded; when asked whether to rely on this, he said to act, since each is facilitated, then recited al-Layl 92:5–10.
IBNHIBBAN:335/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه كان في جنازة فأخذ عودا ينكت في الأرض

IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r1.author: Ibn Ḥibbān
IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r1.claim: ʿAlī reports that the Prophet said each person's place in Paradise or Hell is recorded; when asked whether to rely on this, he said to act, since each is facilitated, then recited al-Layl 92:5–10.
IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r1.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه كان في جنازة فأخذ عودا ينكت في الأرض

IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r2.author: Ibn Ḥibbān
IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r2.speaker: شعبة
IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r2.claim: Shuʿba adds that Manṣūr ibn al-Muʿtamir also narrated the report to him, corroborating its transmission from Sulaymān al-Aʿmash.
IBNHIBBAN:v2p47#2/r2.anchor: قال شعبة حدثني منصور بن المعتمر فلم أنكره من حديث سليمان

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r1.claim: Giving apparently means giving wealth, but also giving what is due in every matter, by word and deed; withholding likewise covers faith and required speech or action.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r1.anchor: وظاهر ذلك إعطاء المال ،   وهي أيضاً تتناول إعطاء الحق في كل شيء ،   قول وفعل

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r2.claim: A report says the verse concerns Abū Bakr, who freed weak enslaved Muslims and spent for the Prophet's sake, unlike the unbelievers.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r2.anchor: ويروى أن هذه الآية نزلت في أبي بكر الصديق ،   وذلك أنه كان يعتق ضعفة العبيد

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r3.speaker: عبد الله بن أبي أوفى
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r3.claim: Ibn Abī Awfā said the sūra was revealed about Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq and Abū Sufyān ibn Ḥarb.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r3.anchor: قال عبد الله بن أبي أوفى : نزلت هذه السورة في أبي بكر الصديق وأبي سفيان بن حرب

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r4.speaker: مقاتل
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r4.claim: Muqātil reports that Abū Bakr bought Bilāl from Abū Sufyān after seeing him torture Bilāl.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r4.anchor: وقال مقاتل : مر أبو بكر على أبي سفيان وهو يعذب بلالاً فاشتراه منه

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r5.speaker: السدي
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r5.claim: Al-Suddī says the verse arose from Abū al-Daḥdāḥ buying a palm tree from a hypocrite to give fruit to a Muslim widow's orphans, after the Prophet's offer of a palm in Paradise was refused.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r5.anchor: وقال السدي : نزلت هذه الآية بسبب أبي الدحداح الأنصاري ،   وذلك أن نخلة لبعض المنافقين

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r6.claim: A Bukhārī report has the Prophet say this wording about the date clusters Abū al-Daḥdāḥ hung in the mosque as charity; no grading is stated here.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r6.anchor: وفي البخاري أن هذا اللفظ كان رسول الله صلى الله عيله وسلم يقوله في الأقناء

IBNATIYYA:92:5/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r7.claim: These occasion reports are associated with the position that some sūras contain Medinan revelation.
IBNATIYYA:92:5/r7.anchor: وهذا كله قول من يقول بعض السور مدني

IBNKATHIR:92:5/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:92:5/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:92:5/r1.claim: The giver gives what he has been commanded to give and fears God in his affairs.
IBNKATHIR:92:5/r1.anchor: أي : أعطى ما أمر بإخراجه ،   واتقى الله في أموره

MAWARDI:92:5/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:92:5/r1.speaker: ابن مسعود
MAWARDI:92:5/r1.claim: Ibn Masʿūd identifies the giver in the verse as Abū Bakr.
MAWARDI:92:5/r1.anchor: قال ابن مسعود يعني أبا بكر .

MAWARDI:92:5/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:92:5/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI:92:5/r2.anchor: أحدها : من بذل ماله ،   قاله ابن عباس

MAWARDI:92:5/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:92:5/r3.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI:92:5/r3.claim: Being God-fearing means avoiding the prohibitions God has forbidden.
MAWARDI:92:5/r3.anchor: الثاني : اتقى محارم الله التي نهى عنها ،   قال قتادة .

NASAFI:92:5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:92:5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:92:5/r1.claim: The generous person gives the rights due from his wealth.
NASAFI:92:5/r1.anchor: { فَأَمَّا مَنْ أعطى } حقوق ماله { واتقى } ربه فاجتنب محارمه

NASAFI:92:5/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:92:5/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:92:5/r2.claim: He fears his Lord and avoids His prohibitions.

QURTUBI:92:5/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:5/r1.speaker: ابن مسعود وعامة المفسرين
QURTUBI:92:5/r1.claim: Ibn Masud and most commentators identify the person who gives and is mindful as Abu Bakr.
QURTUBI:92:5/r1.anchor: قال ابن مسعود : يعني أبا بكر رضي اللّه عنه ، وقاله عامة المفسرين

QURTUBI:92:5/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:5/r2.speaker: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير
QURTUBI:92:5/r2.claim: Amir ibn Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr reports that Abu Bakr freed elderly women for Islam; when his father urged him to free strong men who could defend him, Abu Bakr said he wanted what he wanted.
QURTUBI:92:5/r2.anchor: فروى عن عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير قال : كان أبو بكر يعتق على الإسلام عجائز ونساء ، قال : فقال له أبوه قحافة : أي بني لو أنك أعتقت رجالا جلدا يمنعونك

QURTUBI:92:5/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:5/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI:92:5/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas says أعطى means to give or spend.
QURTUBI:92:5/r3.anchor: وعن ابن عباس في قوله تعالى : " فأما من أعطى " أي بذل

QURTUBI:92:5/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:5/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI:92:5/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says واتقى means avoiding the things God has forbidden.
QURTUBI:92:5/r4.anchor: " واتقى " أي محارم اللّه التي نهى عنها

QURTUBI:92:6/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:6/r2.speaker: أبو هريرة عن النبي
QURTUBI:92:6/r2.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet saying that two angels descend each morning, one asking God to recompense the spender and the other to ruin the miser.
QURTUBI:92:6/r2.anchor: وفي صحيح مسلم عن أبي هريرة قال : قال رسول اللّه صلى اللّه عليه وسلم : ( ما من يوم يصبح العباد فيه إلا

QURTUBI:92:6/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:6/r3.speaker: أبو الدرداء عن النبي
QURTUBI:92:6/r3.claim: Abu al-Darda reports that at sunset two angels call for recompense for the spender and loss for the miser; the passage was revealed in connection with this.
QURTUBI:92:6/r3.anchor: وروى من حديث أبي الدرداء : أن رسول اللّه صلى اللّه عليه وسلم قال : ( ما من يوم غربت شمسه إلا بعث

QURTUBI:92:6/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:6/r4.speaker: أهل التفسير
QURTUBI:92:6/r4.claim: Exegetes take the giver to be someone who gives to people in hardship.
QURTUBI:92:6/r4.anchor: وقال أهل التفسير : " فأما من أعطى " المعسرين

QURTUBI:92:6/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:6/r5.speaker: قتاده
QURTUBI:92:6/r5.claim: Qatada says the giver is one who gives God the due owed to Him.
QURTUBI:92:6/r5.anchor: وقال قتاده : أعطى حق اللّه تعالى الذي عليه

QURTUBI:92:6/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:92:6/r6.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI:92:6/r6.claim: Al-Hasan says the giver offers truth from his heart.
QURTUBI:92:6/r6.anchor: وقال الحسن : أعطى الصدق من قلبه

RAZI:92:1/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:1/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:92:1/r2.claim: Despite that reported occasion, the sūra’s meaning is general, as its statements that human striving differs and that a blazing fire is warned of show.
RAZI:92:1/r2.anchor: إلا أنها وإن كانت كذلك لكن معانيها عامة للناس

RAZI:92:1/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:1/r3.speaker: علي
RAZI:92:1/r3.claim: ʿAlī reports that at a funeral the Prophet said God knows every soul’s place in Paradise or Hell; when asked whether to rely on this, he said to act, since each is facilitated for what they were created for.
RAZI:92:1/r3.anchor: ويروى عن علي عليه السلام أنه قال : «خرجنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

RAZI:92:5/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:5/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:92:5/r1.claim: The paired descriptions explain how differing deeds lead to good or bad outcomes, reward or punishment.
RAZI:92:5/r1.anchor: ثم إنه سبحانه بين معنى اختلاف الأعمال فيما قلناه من العاقبة المحمودة

RAZI:92:5/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:5/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:92:5/r2.claim: One reading is spending wealth in every good cause, such as freeing slaves and captives and strengthening Muslims against enemies, whether obligatory or voluntary; Abū Bakr did so.
RAZI:92:5/r2.anchor: أن يكون المراد إنفاق المال في جميع وجوه الخير من عتق الرقاب

RAZI:92:5/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:5/r3.speaker: author
RAZI:92:5/r3.claim: This broad sense parallels the Qurʾānic description of believers spending from what God provided, whether obligatory or voluntary.
RAZI:92:5/r3.anchor: وإطلاق هذا كالإطلاق في قوله : { ومما رزقناهم ينفقون }

RAZI:92:5/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:5/r4.speaker: author
RAZI:92:5/r4.claim: Another reading includes giving the rights of wealth and of the self through obedience; Arabic usage also says someone “gave obedience.”
RAZI:92:5/r4.anchor: أن قوله : { أعطى } يتناول إعطاء حقوق المال وإعطاء حقوق النفس

RAZI:92:5/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:92:5/r5.speaker: author
RAZI:92:5/r5.claim: Taqwā means guarding oneself against everything improper; Rāzī refers to his earlier discussion of whether avoiding minor sins is required.
RAZI:92:5/r5.anchor: فهو إشارة إلى الاحتراز عن كل مالا ينبغي

BURHAN:v3p454/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p454/r6.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p454/r6.claim: When a condition is shared across one set of traits, its opposite must be shared across their opposites: giving, piety, and belief pair with withholding, self-sufficiency, and denial.
BURHAN:v3p454/r6.anchor: لما جعل التيسير مشتركا بين الآعطاء والتقى والتصديق وجعل ضده وهو التعسير مشتركا بين أضداد تلك الأمور
